desc: INTRODUCING THE BERETTA BRX1 RANCH RIFLE - a revolutionary, compact, true straight-pull reloading rifle designed for precision shooting & hunting now in a ranch rifle configuration. The fastest manually repeating platform available features an 8-lug rotating bolt head and lock-up system, ambidextrous controls, and a single-stage trigger for top-notch performance. With guaranteed sub-MOA accuracy, quick barrel, bolt, and mag swaps, and adjustable ergonomics, it offers the ultimate flexibility for shooters.
